head: kooiin
visible_features: GDT1059 records one large round leaf and an emphasized chain of underground bodies; exact kooiin also heads visually different f29v
botanical_comparator: Borago has bristly leaves and loose star-shaped blue flowers (RHS); no decisive species match established

head: fochor
visible_features: Five large unequal blue-pale-yellow petals per flower; darker upper petals; pointed simple leaves plus deeply cut leaflike structures
botanical_comparator: Viola tricolor has two dark upper petals, pale or yellow lower petals and divided stipules; Centaurea jacea has composite thistlelike heads (Flora of North America; RHS)

head: tshol
visible_features: Compact herb-like crown with many small blue pronged flowers above several exposed spiny carrot-like roots
botanical_comparator: Tilia is a tree with broad heart-shaped leaves and pale pendent flower clusters (RHS)

head: tchodar
visible_features: Round teal unlobed leaves; several dark blue terminal flower clusters; branching tapered roots
botanical_comparator: Conium/Cicuta hemlocks have dissected leaves and small pale flowers in compound umbels (Kew; World Flora Online)
